name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Creates, submits, reviews, approves, rejects and exports expense claims.

dependencies.name: category-agent
dependencies.description: Gets a suggested category for an expense line before the employee confirms it.

description: The single-page app for employees, managers and finance: submitting and tracking claims, reviewing and deciding a team's claims, and running payroll exports. Role-specific screens are gated by sign-in; it holds no business logic of its own.
